titulo_es: Choose to give or receive according to the point of view

bloques.titulo: It presents something that I or my group give; it's something that someone gives to my group; it's something I get.
texto: The speaker's point of view determines the verb. The receiver is usually marked with the person who gives it in the same way as the person who gives it in the same way.
I gave flowers to my friend.
